insert into episode_progress (user_id, episode_id, position_sec, duration_sec, updated_at) values
(#{r.userId}, #{r.episodeId}, #{r.positionSec}, #{r.durationSec}, #{r.updatedAt})
on conflict (user_id, episode_id) do update set position_sec = excluded.position_sec, duration_sec = excluded.duration_sec, updated_at = excluded.updated_at where episode_progress.updated_at <= excluded.updated_at
